notes: Read all 340 source lines line by line before editing. Every line is accounted for below; behaviour, state names, API paths, unit handling, i18n keys+defaults, and the page's section order (header actions -> hero gauge -> 6 stat tiles -> monthly trend chart -> regen-metrics bars -> recent-drives table) are preserved. The native file header documents every web->native remap.

L1 `import { useMemo }`: kept; the native file also pulls React + useCallback/useEffect/useRef/useState/useSyncExternalStore/ReactNode for the inlined shims, the shared selected-vehicle store, and the mount-fade animation.

L2 react-i18next useTranslation -> inlined useNativeTranslation(): a stable (key, fallback, options?) shim. It reproduces i18next `{{name}}` interpolation against the English fallback so L160's recovered-info line keeps {{energy}}/{{charges}}; every other t('key','English') keeps its English default verbatim (i18n intent preserved).

L3 lucide-react Zap/Activity/Calendar -> SemanticIcon glyphs: Zap->'bolt' (Total Regen / Free Charges / Lifetime Regen stat tiles + Recent Regen Drives heading), Activity->'activity' (Recovery Rate / Lifetime Drive tiles + Regen Metrics heading + recent-drives EmptyState), Calendar->'calendar' (Monthly Avg tile). lucide SVG has no native renderer; the per-tile decorative colours (green/cyan/amber/purple/emerald/orange) collapse to the SemanticIcon's fixed semantic tone (documented).

L4 @/components/layout PageContainer -> inline native PageContainer (title + subtitle + always-visible actions + loading spinner / error banner / children, mirroring the web header + loading?Spinner:error?box:children branches). The web `empty` prop is unused by this page (it handles the empty branch inside children).
L5 @/components/ui GlassPanel -> the shared native GlassPanel (apps/native/src/components/ui/GlassPanel), used for the hero, each stat tile, the metrics panel, and the table panel.

L6 @/components/ui HelpTooltip -> inline native HelpTooltip: native has no hover surface, so the '?' (helpCircle) glyph is a Pressable that toggles an inline help bubble and also carries the help body as accessibilityLabel so assistive tech reads it. The web size='sm' + i18nKey + defaultValue + ariaLabel are preserved (body=t('help.regenEfficiency.body',<default>), ariaLabel=t('help.regenEfficiency.iconLabel','More info about regen metrics')).

L7-11 @/components/charts ChartContainer/ChartTooltip/AREA_DEFAULTS/renderAnnotationLines/ComposedChart/Line/Bar/XAxis/YAxis/CartesianGrid/Tooltip/ResponsiveContainer -> an inline ChartContainer (title + ariaLabel as the GlassPanel accessibilityLabel + min-height body) wrapping the shared native AreaChartWrapper. The dual-axis ComposedChart (Bar drives right-axis #a855f7 + Line regenKwh left-axis #10b981) collapses to a two-series AreaChartWrapper on a single Y domain (native has one shared chart primitive); the hover ChartTooltip, the renderAnnotationLines overlay, AREA_DEFAULTS line styling, and the dataColumns CSV/data-table affordance have no native analogue and are dropped (the chart still exposes an accessibilityLabel summary + a latest-value legend). Documented.
